info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Botallac Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Botallac Battery Detail Submission API allows users to introduce detailed information about Botallac battery products into the catalog. This API supports businesses in efficiently managing their product offerings by facilitating the addition of essential specifications and attributes. Typical consumers include inventory managers and product developers who require an organized way to update catalog entries. Through this API, users can streamline their operations, ensuring that product catalogs remain current and comprehensive.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit detailed information regarding the Botallac battery. Ensure all required fields are filled out to successfully process the request.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details required to create or update a Botallac battery operation. It is essential for both retrieving and submitting battery information that meets the specifications outlined in the schema.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the response includes the requested details.
